mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening labor market, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases > 0.5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals a weakening supply chain, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a robust labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals strengthening demand in the housing market, which boosts related sectors and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases over three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.3% month-over-month signals accommodative monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases & CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% MoM.
